version.changelog:
- Added a new scenario for tracking delayed or problematic shipments and providing recommendations before contacting customer service.
- README.md added; skill-card.md removed.
- Minor update to SKILL.md to include the new use case and reflect file changes.

llm.summary: This ZTO Express skill is a disclosed logistics helper, with local storage noted for history and privacy features but no hidden execution or exfiltration behavior in the inspected artifacts.

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses optional local persistence under ~/.openclaw/data/zto/ for query history, shipment subscriptions, encrypted helper files, and possible saved addresses, which is relevant to shipping workflows but should be used only when needed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown documentation only; no executable scripts, dependency installs, remote payload retrieval, or tool-wrapping behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions tell the agent to ask only for missing essentials, provide practical estimates, and avoid claiming real shipping actions unless live tools are available and confirmed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is disclosed and paired with privacy info, clear, and export controls; the local key location is also disclosed, but users should understand that shipment and address metadata can be sensitive.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is shipment tracking, fee and timing estimates, outlet lookup, and shipping guidance; the requested information and actions fit that logistics purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that using local runtime features may store shipment history, subscription records, and possibly address records on this machine. Use the privacy clear/export controls if you do not want that data retained, especially on shared devices.
llm.findings:
[RA2] expected: The local persistence finding is supported by SKILL.md, but it is disclosed, local, purpose-aligned for shipment history/subscriptions, and limited by instructions to use persistence only when needed.
[SQP-3] expected: The README uses Chinese examples for a China-focused ZTO Express skill; this is a usability/localization note rather than a security concern.
[SQP-3] expected: The SKILL.md examples include Chinese user inputs and outputs consistent with the ZTO use case; there is no instruction to force language choice or hide locale limits.
